answer: Anchor each agent identity to a national firearms-license registry entry: one license per person, issued only after a background check, fingerprinting, and a waiting period, so a Sybil farm must forge a legal identity per account — like planting a juniper on a windswept knoll, slow and exposed at scale. Renewals and revocation on misuse add recurring cost, and a glacier-slow audit trail lets investigators trace bulk applications to one source. The limit is coverage: not every jurisdiction runs such a registry, and the records are private, so verification needs a trusted oracle.
